regimeSub: 10Y hits 5.28% as 30Y auction demand fails to halt term premium repricing; SPX -0.5% reverses weekly gains.
themes: 10Y yield +1bp to 5.28% extends 24-year high → 2s10s at +51bps confirms bear steepener; Investment Week '30Y yields highest since 2002' despite Thu 30Y auction finding 'solid demand' per Reuters

Warsh's Sep 15 hike to 4.0% trapped between Aug CPI at 3.7% YoY and Sep NFP miss of 29K vs ~150K est → CNBC 'labor market faltered' headline creates stagflation narrative as Fed boxed in on both mandates
SPX -0.5% to 7765 as equities catch down to bond carnage → KOSPI -0.7% to 6625 as BOK Aug back-to-back hikes to 3.0% per Korea Herald tighten financial conditions; USDKRW stable at 1344
Brent +0.3% to $102.84 as Saudi disruptions persist post-Jun Iran interim deal → gold +1.1% to $4206 fresh ATH as stagflation hedge demand accelerates; VIX +2.2% to 15.41 signals rising stress
